about_short_description.short_description: Carbon Crusher offers carbon crushing as a service to public or private road owner or contractor.

product.name: Crushing as a Service (CRAAS)
product.description: A service that provides road refurbishment by crushing existing asphalt and mixing it with BioBinder, enhancing road strength and reducing carbon footprint.

product.name: BioBinder
product.description: A biopolymer sourced from sustainable forestry used to stabilize and reinforce road structures, making them carbon-negative and more durable.

product.name: SkyRoads
product.description: A software suite for planning, documenting, and surveilling road infrastructure, enabling efficient road management and maintenance.
